visual_brief.subject: A separate authorization service stops research model output at the inference boundary
verified_context: OpenAI says Control Room is deployed across its research infrastructure and tracks agentic inference workloads tied to approved safety cases.
Inference engines check a central job state before fulfilling model-output requests, and stopped jobs are denied further output.
OpenAI reports output can halt within 35 seconds of an intervention decision; the internal system has not been independently audited.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Several workload channels meet one independent gatehouse whose shutter can stop every outgoing stream.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A dark teal gatehouse with a terracotta shutter closes across converging charcoal inference channels.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected at the constitutional gate because it introduced people and a meeting-room scene not needed by the story.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant and strong, but the oversized drawbridge makes the control feel remote from the inference boundary.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The compact gatehouse, converging channels and closed terracotta shutter express centralized, fail-closed authorization without interface imitation.

crop_review.article_desktop: The complete metaphor and separation boundaries remain visible in the wide 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the dominant chamber, gate or transformation and its terracotta signal.
crop_review.thumbnail: The physical silhouette remains distinct at 320px without relying on fine texture.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the golden references in warm paper field, restrained charcoal/teal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile materiality and confident negative space while keeping a story-specific silhouette.
